summary: Join the fun in My Pretend Airport - Kids Travel Town & Airplane City Games!
description:
Pack your Suitcase, and prep your imagination and creative play skills and lets explore and travel in a fun interactive Airport!

Let's go on a trip to the Airport! Touch, interact, and use your imagination and creativity while you play in several rooms in this Giant Interactive Airport!

My Pretend Airport has several rooms to explore, including new additions like the Airport Lounge, and Luggage Pickup zone!

All new characters have been added for your playtime enjoyment! Imagination, Creativity, and Fun are part of the game in this open ended world of Airport fun!

Features Include:

-Grab your luggage, and head over to the Main Terminal where you can shop for gifts, grab snacks, drinks & coffee before your flight!

-Play in the Airplane Cabin & explore all the cubbies, nooks and crannies!

-Place your luggage on the scanner, and see if any items get picked up by the X-Ray machine!

-Drag & drop kids, pilots and other fun characters! Place them into the scenes like a pretend dollhouse!

-My Pretend Airport - Kids Travel town is great for learning fine motor movement, sensory skills & other engaging activities for preschool aged children!

Check out our other games in the My Pretend Series, and explore a World full of imagination and Exploration!
